settings.text:
Fine jewelry is sold strangely. The same ring can cost three times as much on one side of a street as the other, and almost nobody can tell you why. Buy it from overseas and the price finally makes sense — right up until something is wrong with it, and you discover there is nobody to call.

CaratForUs exists in the gap between those two experiences. We price honestly, we tell you exactly what you are getting, and when something needs sorting out you are dealing with us.

settings.title: Priced up from cost, not down from a list price
settings.text: We start from what the metal and the stones actually cost, add a margin we can defend, and show you that number. There is no inflated list price to discount from, so a sale price here would mean the first price was wrong.

settings.title: Buy at today's price, or wait for it to fall
settings.text: Buy Now is the current calculated price for the piece you configure. A Group Buy opens one design for a set window and the price steps down for everyone as more people order — at close, everyone settles at the lowest tier the group reached.

settings.title: Made to your design, or a one-off we cannot repeat
settings.text: Custom Jewelry begins with a $49 design deposit and renders you approve before anything is produced. Luxury Steals are a small number of pieces at a price we will not see again; every one of them is final sale, and we say so before you buy.

settings.title: Already holding a quote
settings.text: Send us a recent written custom quote and we will tell you plainly whether we can beat it. An online listing or a competing group buy we will still review honestly, but without the same guarantee attached — and we tell you which applies before you decide anything.
Browse what is ready to buy today, or read what you get when you buy from us.
